quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #3
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What will help a person who has drunk alcohol feel better?
questions.explanation: Only time will allow alcohol to leave a person's body.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to slow down because a sharp turn is coming.

questions.question: Seat belts work best when worn by:

options.text: All occupants every time the car is driven.

questions.correctAnswerText: All occupants every time the car is driven.
questions.explanation: Everyone in the car should wear a seat belt every time. In a crash, people without seat belts can become flying objects and hurt others in the car.

questions.question: When a school bus stops with its arm extended, drivers should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk the horn before passing on the left.
Keep driving when kids are done exiting.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: You must stop completely when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not move until the arm is pulled back in.

questions.question: When you see a steady green light, you should:

options.text: Drive through, unless vehicles or people are in the intersection.
Stop if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a four-way stop.
Come to a complete stop first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive through, unless vehicles or people are in the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a green light, let pedestrians and other vehicles in the intersection go first. You can drive through if it is clear, but be ready to stop if the light changes.

questions.question: A driver ahead is using one hand and talking to a passenger. You should:

options.text: Know that distracted driving is not safe.

questions.explanation: Do not talk to passengers, look for things in your car, or daydream while driving. If another driver is distracted, stay back because they are more likely to crash.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing from other directions.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow. They alert you to hazards or areas with special rules ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: When driving, you must stop your vehicle:

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
When a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop your vehicle at stop signs, red lights, and whenever a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver is behind you, you should:

options.text: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Stare at the driver as they pass you.
Speed up as they pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: If you encounter an aggressive driver, get out of their way. Do not make eye contact. Speeding up may anger them more and increase danger.

questions.question: When can you text while driving?

options.text: If you can text without looking at your phone.
If you look away from the road for just a moment.

questions.explanation: Texting while driving is illegal. Using a phone while driving is a major distraction and unsafe.

questions.question: To change lanes, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and signal, then change lanes.
Signal, check your mirrors, check your blind spot in the direction you want to move, then change lanes.
Signal, check your mirrors, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, check your mirrors, check your blind spot in the direction you want to move, then change lanes.
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal first. Check your rearview and side mirrors. Look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Make sure no one else is in the lane. Then change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your:
questions.explanation: In fog, use your low beam headlights and fog lights if your vehicle has them. High beams bounce off fog and reduce visibility.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: All people in a vehicle must wear seat belts whenever the vehicle is moving, even if it has airbags.

questions.question: A driver taking a non-prescription drug should:
questions.explanation: Many over-the-counter medicines can affect your driving. Check medicine labels for warnings. Ask your doctor or pharmacist if you are unsure about driving while taking medication.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay to the right.

questions.question: If a tire blows out while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Steer straight and slow down by releasing the gas pedal.
Keep your current speed and steer straight.
Swerve side to side to alert drivers behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer straight and slow down by releasing the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: Hold the steering wheel tight and keep the car straight. Release the gas pedal and do not brake until you have control. Then brake gently and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: A driver's ability can be impaired by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires the driver to be in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness all impair driving ability.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp curve in the road. The arrow shows which way the road curves. You may see several of these signs placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, impairs your coordination, and makes it hard to judge distance. Alcohol also makes you feel overly confident.

questions.question: When passing a stopped emergency vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane or slow down.
Ask the emergency worker if they need help.
Move closer to the emergency vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane or slow down.
questions.explanation: You must move away from the lane closest to a stopped emergency vehicle. If you cannot safely move to another lane, you must slow down.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing and do not see or hear a train. When must you stop?

options.text: If a stop sign is posted.
If a crossing gate is lowered.
If the crossing lights are flashing.

questions.explanation: You must stop before crossing railroad tracks if you see flashing red lights, a lowered gate, a posted stop sign, a flagger signaling you, or a train that is close enough to be unsafe to cross. When in doubt, stop. Never race a train.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Watch carefully for children when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply. Slow down before you reach the sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: You missed your freeway exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up to the exit.
Flag down a police officer for help.

questions.explanation: Take the next exit if you miss yours. Do not stop, back up, swerve across lanes, or cross the median to turn around. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: You hear a siren behind you while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the right and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle behind you, slow down and safely pull to the right side of the road to stop. If traffic is heavy and you cannot move right safely, continue slowly until you can get out of the way.

questions.question: It starts raining while you drive. What should you do?

options.text: Drive at the posted speed limit.
Drive closely behind the car in front of you.

questions.explanation: Slow down when heavy rain reduces your vision. Turn on your headlights so other drivers can see you. If rain is so heavy that you cannot see clearly, pull over and stop until it improves.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile they drive. It is important to focus completely on driving. Any extra task can be dangerous.

questions.question: Which statement about speed is true?

options.text: Driving too slowly on some highways can be dangerous.
Speeding is not dangerous if you are a skilled driver.
Both "Driving too slowly on some highways can be dangerous" and "Speeding can kill."

questions.correctAnswerText: Both "Driving too slowly on some highways can be dangerous" and "Speeding can kill."
questions.explanation: The faster you drive, the more likely a crash will be fatal. At speeds above 80 miles per hour, you have almost no chance of surviving a crash. Driving much slower than other traffic is also dangerous because other drivers may become impatient and make unsafe passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: How much lane space are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other motor vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the full width of a lane, just like all other vehicles.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on major highways?

options.text: Be ready to react to road hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and be ready for unexpected hazards. Do not stare at one thing for more than a few seconds to avoid highway hypnosis.

questions.question: What does alcohol cause?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn you about road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you of a winding road ahead. Slow down and be ready for curves.
